response.justification: Bogdan has 15+ years of full-stack engineering experience spanning web, mobile, and backend systems, with strong recent experience in TypeScript/Node.js and even AI-agent/MCP infrastructure work directly relevant to the role. His depth in testing, CI/CD, architecture, and polyglot programming (D, Java, C#, PHP) exceeds requirements, though direct Nest.js and Vitest experience isn't explicitly mentioned, and current employer overlap (re:cinq) suggests he may already be internally known.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience (15+ years) across frontend, backend, mobile, and embedded systems
Direct current experience with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks, a required skill
Strong testing/CI/CD craftsmanship background (TDD, custom test runners, CI setup)
concerns: No explicit mention of Nest.js or Vitest, the primary stack tools specified
Limited demonstrated cloud/container depth (Docker mentioned, but no clear AWS/GCP/K8s architecture ownership)
Resume shows heavy breadth across many languages/domains, which could indicate less specialization depth in the exact stack

key_factors.factor: Deep full-stack seniority and TypeScript/Node.js experience
